# Portugal resident population estimates by age group

External-source record for the PORDATA series **População residente, estimativas
a 31 de dezembro: total e por grupo etário**.

## Source

- Publisher/interface: PORDATA, Fundação Francisco Manuel dos Santos
- Statistical source: Instituto Nacional de Estatística (INE)
- Series: annual resident-population estimates at 31 December, total and
  five-year age groups
- PORDATA source page:
  https://www.pordata.pt/Portugal/Populacao%2Bresidente%2B%2Bestimativas%2Ba%2B31%2Bde%2BDezembro%2Btotal%2Be%2Bpor%2Bgrupo%2Betario-7

The former local workbook is strongly attributable to a PORDATA-generated Excel
export of the INE-backed series.

## Redistribution decision — terminal unresolved

INE allows rediffusion of official statistical information when the source is
identified. That permission supports reuse of INE statistics, but it does not
automatically establish redistribution rights for PORDATA's own
application-generated Excel serialization.

The re-audit did not recover authoritative PORDATA/FFMS terms that clearly
authorize mirroring the historical workbook bytes.

Evidence:

- https://www.ine.pt/ine_novidades/CSE_2017/105/
- https://www.pordata.pt/About.aspx
- https://www.pordata.pt/Portugal/Populacao%2Bresidente%2B%2Bestimativas%2Ba%2B31%2Bde%2BDezembro%2Btotal%2Be%2Bpor%2Bgrupo%2Betario-7

The registry therefore keeps:

`redistribution: unresolved`

and classifies the blocker as **terminal redistribution-rights**.

No historical Excel bytes are mirrored. The decision can be reopened if
PORDATA/FFMS publishes explicit export-redistribution terms, or if the registry
replaces the artifact with a directly sourced INE representation governed by
INE reuse terms.
